note: Whirlpool architecture derived from manual evidence before any comparison to Samsung candidate.

modelNomenclature.excerpt: W = Washer; C = All-In-One (vs W = Washer-only in same manual family)

aioQualification.rationale: Manual explicitly defines C = All-In-One product line on single front-load platform. Combo models add integrated dry subsystem (dry heater, dry blower, vent fan, condenser duct) on shared drum/ACU. Quick Service Cycle and component activation span wash and dry functions in one cabinet without load transfer.
aioQualification.notStackedLaundry: GE GUD27-class stacked center excluded — W11169652 is single-chassis FL platform
aioQualification.notFlexWashDualLoad: Single drum architecture — not dual-load FlexWash
aioQualification.notAccessoryOnly: Dry subsystem is integrated factory configuration on C models, not aftermarket accessory
aioQualification.notStandaloneDryer: Dry functions are subsystem of washer chassis controlled by same ACU
